references.text: Share your bread with the hungry, and bring the homeless poor into your house! When you see someone naked, clothe them, and do not turn away from your own flesh and blood!
He lifts the poor out of the dust and raises the needy from the ash heap.
The Lord gives justice to the oppressed, gives bread to the hungry. The Lord sets the prisoners free.
If there is a poor person among your brothers in any of the towns in the land that the Lord your God is giving you, do not harden your heart or shut your hand against your poor brother.
He secures justice for widows and fatherless children and loves the foreigner, giving them food and clothing. So love the foreigner.
The parable of the Good Samaritan, showing love toward a stranger by caring for him.
Religion that is pure and undefiled before God our Father is this: to care for orphans and widows in their distress and to keep oneself unstained by the world.

Do not forget to show hospitality, for through it some have entertained angels without knowing it. Remember those in prison as if you were bound with them, and those who are mistreated as if you yourselves were suffering.
